summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.87/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.87 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 10, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 14¢ lower than a week ago, 45¢ lower than a month ago, and 98¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.63) and the highest in Stevens Point ($4.09).
